name: Credits
description: A title in quotes in tall condensed capitals with up to five credit lines under it, centred; empty lines close up.

controls.name: Title
controls.description: Shown in capitals between curly quotes; a long title breaks onto two lines; leave it empty for none (the lines move up).

controls.name: Line 1
controls.default: Filmed and edited by Your Name

controls.name: Line 5
controls.description: Credit lines left empty close up.

controls.name: Line Font
controls.description: Font of all five credit lines.

controls.name: Position
controls.description: Centre of the whole block, in frame pixels (9x16: [540, 800]).

controls.name: Max Width
controls.description: Widest any line may be, in % of the frame width; a wider line shrinks to fit.

controls.name: Shadow
controls.description: Strength of the soft shadow under the text, 0 to 100.

controls.name: Start
controls.description: When it starts to fade and rise in, in seconds (0.6 s in).

controls.name: Duration
controls.description: Length of the rendered clip in seconds; it fades out over its last 0.5 s.
